description: This file defines a React component 'OrderDetailPage' that displays detailed information about a specific order, including tracking, items, shipping address, and reordering options. It interacts with external services and APIs for data fetching and user notifications.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function to load order data and backend mode status, updating component state accordingly.

methods.name: onAdvance
methods.description: Function to advance the order status when invoked, updating the order if successful.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Function to re-add in-stock items of the order to the shopping cart and notify the user.
